title: CRITICAL: capstone dogfood — author a basic Flash game end-to-end and verify in Ruffle
description: North-star MVP acceptance test — the project is not done until this passes. Author a small game (avoider/pong/catcher) using only the tool's interfaces (preferred: the agent MCP bridge 0613-0615 / JSFL; no hand-written SWF bytes): draw shapes, create symbols incl. a Button, animate on the timeline, write AS2 (onEnterFrame game loop, Key input, MovieClip.hitTest, score in a TextField, gotoAndStop for game-over), publish the SWF, and verify it actually plays in Ruffle using the interactivity oracle (0518): synthesized clicks/keys change game state on screen. Every gap or bug discovered becomes a new task. Blocked by 0518; the MCP bridge suite (0613-0615) is the intended authoring vehicle but JSFL is an acceptable fallback if it lands later.
